The '''Lerantha Footpath''' was a road that led through the eastern mountains of [[Kaamos Territory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], leading from the [[Fornaak River]] to [[Lerantha Lake]]. The [[Thul research camp]] was located along the trail, as was the bridge to the underground part of the [[Lerantha Dam]].
